title: Markdown-embedded [autodoc()] tags for doc-to-doc freshness
description:
Extend autodoc's two-way freshness mechanism to support [autodoc()] tags embedded inside markdown files as HTML comments, enabling doc-to-doc dependency tracking (e.g., a SKILL.md depending on a requirements doc, or a high-level doc restating constraints from a lower-level spec).

Full technical design (resolved, ready to implement):
  auto-doc/docs/markdown-embedded-tags-tech-design.md

Key properties:
- Tag syntax: <!-- [autodoc(docId@docHash, scopeHash)] --> on its own line
- Scope selection by markdown heading depth (not indentation)
- Markdown scan limited to files already in the doc index (no repo-wide .md walk)
- autodoc fixed rewrites scopeHash but never docHash; skips rewrite when docHash is stale
- E2E test covers whole-doc scope, section scope, overlapping scopes, orphaned tags, self-reference, skip-when-stale, line-ending preservation

Not included: transitive drift, automatic semantic rewrites, setext headings.
close_reason: Implementation already on main — ScopeKindMarkdown, ScanMarkdownDocs, markdown.go, rewriteMarkdownTagScopeHashes, and E2E tests all present and passing

title: auto-ui: dedup backends by learned hostId to prevent double relay delivery
description:
Follow-up from PR #108 (task 047) review. The BackendManager (auto-ui/internal/backend/manager.go:337) subscribes to each registered URI independently and stores c.hostID = status.HostID, but never dedups connections by learned hostId. If an operator registers the same autowatch daemon under two different URIs — only possible by bypassing config validation with 'auto ui backends add --no-verify', since duplicate hostIds are detected after connect — the Manager subscribes on both connections and relays the same event twice, producing duplicate doc.changed notifications/repaints.

Task 047 removed auto-ui's eventGate (id-dedup) by decision D-2 because the single ingest path (autowatch) can't double-deliver. That holds for the ingest path; this is a distinct duplicate-SUBSCRIPTION case. The correct fix is at the backend layer (close/skip a connection whose learned hostId already has a live connection), NOT re-adding a TTL id-gate in front of the hub. Belongs with the multi-host backend work (046), out of 047's ingest-path scope.
